# Rosalind Problem: Convert a Peptide Vector into a Peptide

## Problem Description
Given a peptide vector, convert it into the corresponding peptide string.

A peptide vector is a binary string where:
- 1 indicates the presence of an amino acid with mass equal to the position
- 0 indicates absence

The amino acid masses are: 57, 71, 86, 99, 103, 113, 114, 128, 131, 137, 147, 156, 163, 186
